offering_description.value: Provides insurance brokerage, risk management, claims administration and consulting to businesses, public entities, nonprofits and individuals. It earns commissions and fees by placing insurance coverage and administering claims and benefit programs for clients, supported by risk control and analytics services.

primary_products.value: insurance coverage placements; risk and benefits analytics tools

primary_services.value: insurance brokerage; claims administration; risk control consulting; benefits consulting; program administration

customer_segment.value: B2B: businesses of all sizes, nonprofits, associations, and private institutions; B2C: individuals buying personal insurance such as home and auto; B2G: municipalities, school districts, and other public entities

end_markets.value: construction; healthcare; manufacturing; hospitality; public sector

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: commissions on insurance placed with carriers and fees for program and claims administration; service fees: benefits consulting, risk control and analytics services paid by clients
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: places client insurance risk with insurance carriers and receives commissions from them; service provider: takes in fees for claims handling and consulting, sold to employers and public entities

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, and many other countries through its brokerage network

specialization.value: related lines: insurance brokerage, claims administration, risk control and benefits consulting sharing corporate clients

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: account executives serving corporate and public entity clients; agents / brokers: local offices and partner brokers placing coverage for individual clients

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance producer licenses from state insurance regulators and authorization from UK and other foreign financial regulators
